title: 8 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Major Shonen jump Series Unveils First Look At Finale
content: Based on the award-winning Shonen manga written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, Dr. Stone ’s anime adaptation is all set for its finale in a few weeks. The anime returns with part 3 of its final season in April, as part of the Spring 2026 lineup.
author: ComicBook

title: 27 Years Later, Classic Fantasy Film Is Coming to Theaters
content: Revolutionary Girl Utena is like the darker, more mature cousin of Sailor Moon . The anime centers on Utena Tenjou, a girl who dreams of becoming a prince and finds herself drawn into a surreal world of duels, roses, and cryptic mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: 37 Years Later, Studio Ghibli’s Beloved Classic Gets an Official New Sequel
content: Thanks to the massive popularity of Studio Ghibli , fans are always awaiting updates on new projects and even theatrical re-releases. The studio is famous for its beautifully crafted animated films, rich storytelling, deep emotional impact, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: KADOKAWA CEO Partly Blames Increase in New Anime Companies for Making Anime 'Less Profitable'
content: In comments made last month, KADOKAWA CEO Takeshi Natsuno said there were too many anime and publishing companies, and the numerous new entrants in the anime industry were making it less profitable.

title: A Long Lost Godzilla Villain Returns This Year

title: Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo Plans to Reopen in September After March Stabbing Incident
content: ANN's staff confirmed that the Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo has had security guards stationed around the venue since March 27. Other Pokémon Centers (which have remain opened) have stationed security guards, particularly in their register area.
author: ANN

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Takes Dominating Fifth Win in Week 8 of Spring 2026
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has topped the weekly Spring 2026 anime rankings for the fifth time after its latest episode. The anime had over 20.08% of the total votes this time, which is the highest total tally so far in the season.
author: Anime Corner

title: Deadline: Hotaru's Way Gets U.S. Live-Action Series from Unapologetic Projects
content: Deadline wrote a summary: Hotaru is a polished executive assistant who spends her days in red bottoms and blazers and her nights in dirty sweats, eating takeout and binging reality TV in the apartment she sublets from her former boss, per the logline.

title: Studio MAPPA’s Most Controversial Anime Returns
content: Studio MAPPA has become a heavy hitter in the anime industry, thanks to bringing to life some of the biggest anime franchises to life. Since first swinging open its doors in 2011, the production house has released the likes of Attack on Titan’s final season, Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man , and Hell’s Paradise .
